description: Choose Parquet partition columns from a schema and a query log, and deliver a partition plan and config. Before writing a large Parquet table, to fix partitioning. Do not choose this when you need statistics-driven partitioning, which needs table stats. Example requests: How should I partition this Parquet table? | Plan the partitioning for this dataset. | Choose partition columns from this query log.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

query_log.description: The customer's queries.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text. The query log, one query per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

schema.description: The customer's schema.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The table schema. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_parquet_partition_planner
title: Parquet partition planner
